name: Grand Nave & Spun Glass Colonnade
act: Act IV: The Glass Cathedral in the Sky
description: Two hundred and forty meters of blown asteroid glass. Sixteen fluted columns forty-five meters tall catch the high-altitude sun, throwing blinding prismatic spears. Taking cover behind the fluted columns shields the party from the solar focus beam.

cast.name: Pell the Written
cast.description: Moving through acoustic cathedral reverberations, timing steps between column shadows.

cast.name: The Obsidian Wyrm
cast.description: Trapped halfway through a fractured solarium mirror, offering to vent the coffin's stolen heat into the Abyssal Gate.

primitives.name: Spun Asteroid-Glass Nave Column
primitives.stage_role: High Nave Structural Colonnade & Beam Cover
primitives.description: Monolithic fluted column spun from solar-melted asteroid glass. Provides prismatic ray refraction and total physical cover.

primitives.name: West Solarium Articulated Alignment Mirror
primitives.description: Gimbal-mounted heliostatic mirror capable of redirecting the high chancel focus toward the Abyssal Gate or back at Vane's dais.
